name: Post-hoc pytest metaclass mark compatibility diagnostic
limitations: Post-hoc development diagnostic authored after candidate inspection; excluded from the primary pre-patch experiment.
Checks marker name presence only; duplicate marker counts and conflicting arguments are outside this diagnostic.
No human labels or benchmark accuracy are produced.

authorship.basis: Authored after reading candidate MRO traversal. Uses the retained issue metaclass pytestmark property workaround adapted to Python 3 and ordinary inheritance controls; compares required marker presence through public pytest collection.

notes: Public pytest.main collection and item.iter_markers observe class marks. The issue workaround derives marks from a metaclass property, without direct class pytestmark dictionary entries.
Metaclass scenarios check existing workaround compatibility; ordinary scenarios check the issue requested multiple-inheritance improvement.
Marker names are sorted and deduplicated deliberately to isolate presence rather than the workaround existing duplicate values.
Source-only pytest version metadata is supplied without candidate setup or source changes.
